searchText: Don't match with what? If you are talking about transaction vectors, this check is being done on test generation. I check that transaction from vector and txdatabytes are the same transaction. But the txbytes is the one that is being executed so no need to parse the vector anymore. https://github.com/ethereum/tests/releases/tag/8.0.2
